8. If stamps or signatures are used, ensure they’re replicated or have another inspector stand in without them knowing the documentation was altered.
9. Date the updated document appropriately to match the inspection's original date.
10. Ensure no eraser marks or corrections are visible that could indicate tampering.
11. Double-check to ensure changes are subtle and undetectable upon a cursory review.
